mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits aldehyde dehydrogenase and may impair niacin metabolism, potentially increasing niacin levels and adverse effects; niacin can cause vasodilation and flushing which may complicate disulfiram's effects.
action: Monitor for increased niacin adverse effects (flushing, pruritus, hepatotoxicity); consider dose adjustment or alternative agent if excessive niacin effects develop; assess liver function regularly as both drugs can affect hepatic function.
